rtl_config_fields.default: Value in the default build (./run, ./run_all -fast) and the base of the sim_* configs of bin/sim_configs.py
rtl_config_fields.rtl_default: RTL default when it differs from 'default'; the shared configs of bin/rtl_configs.py (also linted, VC-checked and synthesised) are overrides of the RTL defaults
rtl_config_fields.bench_only: Testbench switch, not an RTL parameter

test_fields.name: Stimulus file basename in sim/rtl_sim/src/
test_fields.requires: Optional Python expression over the parameter names; the test runs in a config only where it holds (malformed = load error). Tests still skip themselves (tb_skip_finish) where a VRAM size is too small
test_fields.min_checks: Optional: the fewest comparisons the common check tasks must count for the test to pass (bench define BLNS_MIN_CHECKS, default 1); 0 for a test whose comparisons are all its own

VRAM_WORDS.description: VRAM depth in 32-bit words (1 - 2^24); free-valued, the sweep sets the extremes

VRAM_RD_LAT.description: VRAM macro read latency in cycles (1 = plain synchronous SRAM)

VRAM_RD_REG_EN.description: VRAM read data registered: one more read cycle (slow macros)

GPU_XY_EN.description: GPU x/y coordinates, clip window and affine blits

GPU_RUNAHEAD_EN.description: GPU run-ahead: decode and set up the next primitive while one draws

GPU_REMAP_EN.description: GPU palette remap (SET_AUX REMAP_TABLE, REMAP fields)

GPU_MPLANE_EN.description: GPU mask plane on copies (SET_AUX MASK_PLANE, EXEC_COPY MPLANE)

GPU_IMM_EN.description: GPU immediate source (SET_SRC IMM: COPY / COPY_TRANSP / EXPAND data from GPU_CMD)

GPU_LINE_EN.description: GPU lines: EXEC_FILL LINE, SET_AUX LINE_PEN / LINE_PATTERN, dashes; anti-aliased with GPU_BLEND_EN (needs GPU_XY_EN)

GPU_BILINEAR_EN.description: GPU bilinear texture sampling: SET_AUX TEX_FILTER (BILINEAR, TBORDER with GPU_BLEND_EN), a 2 x 2 tap cache and the tap MAC stage (needs GPU_XY_EN)

DIF_TYPE.description: Built-in display driver: 0=BDI (none, BDI exported), 1=DBI_SPI, 2=DBI_PAR (8080), 3=DBI_PAR_SPI, 4=DPI, 5=HDMI (DPI and TMDS encoder)

DPI_SCALER.description: DPI scaler: 0 none, 1 nearest, 2 nearest and bilinear (DIF_TYPE 4 and 5)

DPI_PCLK_SEP.description: DPI panel timing on its own pixel clock (DIF_TYPE 4 and 5)

DPI_ISLAND_EN.description: HDMI mode: guard bands and InfoFrame data islands (DIF_TYPE 5)

DPI_AUDIO_EN.description: HDMI audio from an I2S input and the generic packet (DIF_TYPE 5, needs DPI_ISLAND_EN)

CURSOR_EN.description: Hardware cursor (32 x 32, 2 bpp, overlaid on the refresh): 0=absent, 1=present

ICG_EN.description: Bench only: gate hclk through an ICG model driven by hclk_en_o

VRAM_POISON.description: Bench only: the VRAM model drives random read data in every cycle but a read's data cycle (no hold between reads)

PCLK_HALF.description: Bench only: DPI pixel-clock half period in 100 ps units (HCLK period 10 ns: 73 = 7.3 ns, pclk/hclk 0.68), the clock the tests start with and return to

SYNC_JITTER.description: Bench only: define ARV_SYNC_JITTER (arv_synchronizer captures a changed bit one edge late at random, seeded from SEED)

MACRO_FREECLK.description: Bench only: the VRAM and LUT macro models (and the VRAM read pipeline) on the free-running clock instead of the gated hclk (with ICG_EN = 1)

GPU_RS_SEEDS.description: Bench only: seed streams gpu_rstream runs one after the other in one simulation (the T2 seed configs sim_rs_*)

tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BLEND_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=38400 and DIM_W>=8

tests.name: gpu_mix5
tests.description: SET_ALPHA MIX5 (LVGL's blend rule) in every blend at 16 bpp against the shared model: model arithmetic against hand values and LVGL's packed mix; FILL / COPY / COPY_TRANSP / SPAN / EXPAND / MASK / TEXSPAN / TEXRECT / triangles / mask plane / immediate / AA lines, x/y and clip, A at the rule's edges, EN off, MIX5 back to 0, RESET_STATE, palette modes
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BLEND_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=38400 and DIM_W>=8

tests.name: gpu_a8_copy
tests.description: RGB565A8 copies (SRC_FMT 5, SET_AUX ALPHA_PLANE): alpha edges with and without MIX5, EN with A 0 / 1 / 128 / 254 / 255, the no-D predicate's edges (252 / 253, EN, A 255, MIX5), key then alpha, ops 0 / 5 / 13-15, every swap and CL, x/y clipping, odd alpha offsets; image, D read counts, A8 words read only, one destination word with 255 then 128 and 128 then 255; palette modes ignore it
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BLEND_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_a8_tex
tests.description: RGB565A8 textures: TEXSPAN / TEXRECT / textured triangles with SRC_FMT 5 (power-of-two wrap, free pitch, BOUND, TRANSP_EN key then alpha, SET_ALPHA EN, MIX5); image and allowed words (A8 words of read texels only)
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BLEND_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_a8_err
tests.description: Per-pixel alpha errors: SRC_FMT 5 / ALPHA_PLANE / TEX_FILTER causes in every build (absent, PITCH, TBORDER, SEL 6-15, no operand taken, list cut), RGB565A8 with MPLANE or the immediate source (cause 1), EXPAND with SRC_FMT 5 (cause 3), an A8 word past the VRAM (cause 5, a prefix drawn); settings through flushes, RESET_STATE, a cut ALPHA_PLANE / TEX_FILTER

tests.name: gpu_bil_basic
tests.description: Bilinear sampling (TEX_FILTER BILINEAR) against the shared model: the tap MAC and blend against hand values, every weight pair of {0, 1, 7, 8, 16, 24, 31, 32}, texel-aligned and 90-degree blits (one tap), zoom-in / out, random TEXSPAN / TEXRECT / textured triangles, MIX5, SRC_FMT 0 / 5, EN; no-blend builds: the straight colour, TRANSP_EN nearest; BILINEAR 0 and palette modes nearest
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BILINEAR_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_bil_edges
tests.description: Bilinear at the texture edges: BOUND with TBORDER (taps outside the box transparent, not read) and clamp along every box edge and corner (x0 = -1, x0 + 1 = TW, the pixel skip), rotated blits over the box, power-of-two wrap seams, keyed taps, SET_ALPHA per tap, RGB565A8 taps; image and allowed words
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BILINEAR_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_bil_mixd
tests.description: Bilinear interior (alpha256 256, no destination read) and edge pixels in one destination word, both orders: D reads and writes stated; random edge blits with exact destination reads and writes against the model
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BILINEAR_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and GPU_BLEND_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_bil_cache
tests.description: Bilinear tap cache: footprints across words and rows, rotations and zooms (colour reads against the 2 x 2 cache model, A8 companion reads one or two per miss), debug freeze mid-blit (image exact), ABORT mid-blit (a prefix), a W write to a cached word (overlap: the blit ends, the next one exact), VRAM_RD_LAT through the configurations
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BILINEAR_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=10

tests.name: gpu_bnd_prefix
tests.description: ERR_CAUSE 5 raised by stage F keeps the pixels before the faulting one: copies whose source runs past VRAM_WORDS at every depth (REMAP off / SRC / DST, ops reading D, VRAM-window traffic), an immediate COPY with REMAP DST whose index crosses VRAM_WORDS (VRAM_WORDS <= 4096); invariant 14 every cycle, the waiting case required to be reached

tests.name: gpu_bil_err
tests.description: Bilinear errors and state: a tap colour or A8 word past VRAM_WORDS (cause 5, the pixels before it drawn), the filter kept through CLEAR_ERR / ABORT / GPU_EN = 0, nearest after RESET_STATE, a TEX_FILTER cut between its word and operand keeps its word's effect, TEX_FILTER decoded while the previous blit draws (run-ahead) applies to the next one
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_BILINEAR_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=16384 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: gpu_causes
tests.description: Error causes per command: REMAP 3 on every EXEC, immediate-source refusals in lists, absent fields, every reserved format, a list cut after each two-word command, precedence (a list's last word refused without an operand is never a cut), cause 5 for EXPAND / TEXRECT / triangles also in a list; ERR_CAUSE, GPU_ERR, GPU_LIST, no GPU_DONE

tests.name: gpu_call_kinds
tests.description: Command lists of every command kind (FILL with gradient and remap, COPY with remap and mask plane, COPY_TRANSP, SPAN, EXPAND / MASK, TEXSPAN, TEXRECT, flat and textured triangles, SET_ALPHA, SET_AUX, RESET_STATE, FENCE) at 2, 8 and 16 bpp, x/y and address mode, against the model; reserved bits set at random

tests.name: gpu_highmem
tests.description: GPU work at the top of a large VRAM: sources, textures, remap table, mask plane, a command list and destinations in the top 64 K words, every rectangle kind at 1, 8 and 16 bpp, a FILL ending on the last word

tests.name: gpu_ext_hilo
tests.description: GPU address paths from the top of the VRAM back to word 0: the same FILL / COPY (remap, mask plane) / COPY_TRANSP / EXPAND / TEXSPAN / TEXRECT / list / line work (and RGB565A8 and bilinear TEXRECTs) drawn in a top region, then in a bottom one, so every high address bit rises and falls
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and (VRAM_WORDS>=1048576 or (GPU_RUNAHEAD_EN==1 and VRAM_RD_REG_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=32768))

tests.name: gpu_ext_list
tests.description: Length extremes of the command lists and the immediate source: CALL N = 2^24 - 1 (cause 6), a list of VRAM_WORDS - 64 words aborted after its first words, a 5 000-word list run to its end, the immediate source armed with N = 2^24 - 1 then re-armed short, an immediate COPY far longer than its N (262 654 words with a 1 M-word VRAM), CALL N = 0 then N = 2^24 - 1 again (cause 6)
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_IMM_EN==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=38400 and DIM_W>=10

tests.name: gpu_ext_tex
tests.description: Texture operand extremes against the model: TEXBOX above 512, 448 x 480 and 5 x 3 drawn by BOUND TEXRECTs; FREE_PITCH 0xF800 / 0xFFFF / 2048 at 1 bpp with rows up to 1023 then a small pitch (1 M-word VRAM); a texel past the pixel-address range (cause 5, VRAM_WORDS = 2^VRAM_AW); textured triangles about 4 000 pixels wide (DIM_W >= 13)
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and (VRAM_WORDS>=1048576 or (DIM_W>=13 and GPU_TRI_EN==1))

tests.name: gpu_ext_grad
tests.description: Long gradients against the model: x/y FILLs 4 095 pixels wide or tall from -2048 with N from 1 025 to 4 095, clipped to their last pixels (the gradient starts 4 088 to 4 093 steps in), along the run and the lines, plain and RGB, then a short gradient
tests.requires: GPU_EN==1 and GPU_XY_EN==1 and GPU_GRAD_EN==1 and DIM_W>=13 and VRAM_WORDS>=38400

tests.name: gpu_writes
tests.description: When and how the GPU writes: FENCE completes only after the writes of the commands before it are in the VRAM (every primitive kind and depth, window traffic on almost every cycle), each write enables only bytes holding pixels of its rectangle (every depth, swaps, row-end partial words, clip, triangles) while the CPU writes the other bytes of the same words

tests.name: bk_wide
tests.description: Refresh at the largest DISP_SIZE of the build (one line, one column, X/Y and CL swaps, 1 bpp) ending on the last VRAM word, on the BDI pixel stream

tests.name: bk_hilo
tests.description: Refresh from the top of a large VRAM back to word 0: a 16 bpp frame ending on the last word (with the hardware cursor, its block at the top), a 1 bpp frame of the tallest height at pitch 0xFFFF (Y swapped), the same frames from word 0, then a reset (REFR_PITCH back to 0) and a frame after it, on the BDI pixel stream

tests.name: dbi_wide
tests.description: DBI driver with sizes beyond 2047: DFILL and refresh of 4100 x 1 and 1 x 4100 with the hardware window (CASET / PASET high byte 0x10), every panel item checked

tests.name: dpi_status
tests.description: DPI driver status while running: DIF_STATUS LINE against the panel line, VBLANK, REFRESH_BUSY against the frame taken; LINE and VBLANK flags timed against the panel scan; the driver interrupt only from enabled flags; FRAME_CNT and a manual START with DPI frames; debug freeze (the panel goes on, only FRAME_CNT holds)

tests.name: dpi_pclk_stop
tests.description: DPI driver with its pixel clock stopped: UPDATE stays pending, BUSY stays 1 after DPI_EN is cleared, DPI_EN set with the clock stopped (UPDATE 1, staging ignored), exact image once it runs (DPI_PCLK_SEP 1)
tests.requires: DIF_TYPE>=4 and DPI_PCLK_SEP==1 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=6

tests.name: dpi_irq_icg
tests.description: DPI events made on the stop edge (LINE at every stop phase across the line) raise irq_o under the bench clock gate with no bus access
tests.requires: ICG_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE>=4 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=6

tests.name: dpi_reset
tests.description: hresetn_i asserted at instants across a DPI frame with non-default settings: idle panel outputs during the reset, every DPI register and the frame accounting at reset values after it, exact frames once programmed again

tests.name: dpi_reg_walk
tests.description: DPI / HDMI register walk: every staged field with all ones and alternating patterns taken by a start (extreme timing included, LINE = V_ACT at the start), the HDMI fields, DPI_AUD and DPI_PKT0-7 (walking one) taken by a running driver, then exact frames

tests.name: dpi_hd
tests.description: DPI driver on a 1280 x 720 panel: blanking timed, a 320 x 180 frame scaled 4x checked pixel by pixel, LINE and the SCANLINE flag past line 700
tests.requires: DIF_TYPE>=4 and DIM_W>=11 and DPI_LB_AW>=11 and DPI_SCALER>0 and VRAM_WORDS>=28800

tests.name: regs_cursor
tests.description: Hardware cursor registers 0x058-0x06C: reset values, write masks (CURSOR_ADDR [VRAM_AW-1:7], colours [23:0], CTRL [0] [12:8] [20:16], CURSOR_POS whole), BLNS_CFG.CURSOR; all read 0 and ignore writes without CURSOR_EN

tests.name: bk_cursor_basic
tests.description: Hardware cursor on the BDI pixel stream (DIF_TYPE = 0): shape decode, colours, EN, hotspot, every GFX_MODE with the hardware tables and the SW LUT, edges, corners, off-screen and negative positions, a frame smaller than the cursor, two blocks, REFR_PITCH; VRAM reads (two per scan line crossing the cursor)
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE==0 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=6

tests.name: bk_cursor_orient
tests.description: Hardware cursor in every DISP_CFG orientation (X, Y, CL swaps) at positions inside, across each edge, off-screen and negative, the column copy read with CL (a different shape at +64), pixel doubling with odd and even sizes, on the BDI pixel stream; VRAM reads (the doubled line read again)
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE==0 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=6

tests.name: bk_cursor_latch
tests.description: Hardware cursor latch: CURSOR_CTRL / POS / ADDR written during a frame apply from the next one, the colours at once (one switch), a shape rewritten through CURSOR_ADDR without a torn frame, an abandoned frame then an exact one, FREEZE_REFRESH / FREEZE_GPU
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE==0 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=6

tests.name: bk_cursor_bw
tests.description: Hardware cursor reads against the refresh deadlines: short scan lines and CL swap at one pixel per cycle (stalls, never a wrong pixel; bubbles counted), the frame's first pixel under the cursor (latency), contention with the VRAM window and the GPU (urgent cursor reads), on the BDI pixel stream
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE==0 and VRAM_WORDS>=38400 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: dbi_cursor
tests.description: Hardware cursor through the DBI driver (8080 and SPI, RGB565 truncation): orientations and depths, a windowed refresh of a sub-rectangle (HW_WINDOW_EN = 0, the frame pointer, DISP_SIZE and REFR_PITCH moved, the cursor position offset), the cursor hidden
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE in (1,2,3) and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=7

tests.name: dpi_cursor
tests.description: Hardware cursor through the DPI driver (HDMI with DIF_TYPE 5): the stream overlaid in source pixels, scaled with the image (nearest, bilinear), the image placed with a border, test bars without the cursor
tests.requires: CURSOR_EN==1 and DIF_TYPE>=4 and VRAM_WORDS>=1000 and DIM_W>=7
